title: #56 Bob Berridge, Vauxhall Dealersport Cavalier GSi, BTCC 1991
note: Same Vauxhall Sport scheme as Cleland's #5 (05_cleland.json, measured on STR 4718), with 56 on the number board and Berridge on the rear door window. Checked on the Super Touring Register photos of Berridge's car: 4716 (near side-on, right side, mirrored for the number and name sizes: two narrower digits, name about 300 model px wide), 3368 (standing in the paddock, front left three-quarter: same front, Mobil 1 on the rear quarter) and 4714 (in the garage, rear: Mobil 1, Sport band, Philips Car Stereo as on #5), and the Getty photo at Silverstone (6 October, 2201200726, right side). No differences from #5 found apart from number and name. TV caption drawings: only two blurry ones (round 12 Thruxton), consistent with the scheme. Wheels: gold BBS-style cross-spoke with polished lip, from the standing photo STR 3368. QA round: VAUXHALL lowered and a little smaller so it no longer touches the rear door window line (gap as on STR 4717 and Getty LAT 2201201013). Logos (2026-11-16): the Vauxhall griffin roundel, VAUXHALL, both Mobil 1 decals and the Daily Express crusader (added above the paper name) are now the real logos, and the black DUNLOP added ahead of the front Mobil 1; Sport (Vauxhall Sport script), Philips Car Stereo (mixed-case red lettering, not the PHILIPS logo), Daily Express (the logo file is today's all-caps masthead) and both DUNLOP decals (the file adds the flying D, not seen on the car) stay text; the rear bumper CHAMPION (medium), black oval, triangle and wing shield are left out (unidentified). Berridge's left side is not pictured; logos placed as on #5.
